CustomField.description: Mail cycle schedule in days after mail 1 (= the batch release), comma separated: one day per next mail, then the day the member is closed (Completed + Mail Completed Status + moved to the Follow-up Campaign). E.g. "5,12,20" with Max Attempts (Mail) 3: mail 2 on day 5, mail 3 on day 12, closed on day 20. Must have Max Attempts (Mail) values. Empty = every Mail Interval (Days). Read by afl - CampaignMember - Mail Cycle.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days after mail 1, comma separated: each next mail, then the closing day. E.g. 5,12,20 = mail 2 on day 5, mail 3 on day 12, closed on day 20. Empty = Mail Interval (Days).
CustomField.label: Mail Schedule (Days)
